mapper.select: select id , warning_grade as warningGrade from tb_early_warning where node_id =#{stackId} and is_affirm = 2 and node_id is null;
select setting_value from tb_general_setting where setting_key = #{settingKey} order by id
select node_id,warning_grade from tb_general_setting where is_affirm = 0 order by warning_grade desc;

SELECT t.stack_id AS stackId, substring_index(group_concat(t.is_affirm),',',1) AS affirm, substring_index(group_concat(t.warning_grade),',',1) AS warningGrade, substring_index(group_concat(t.node_type),',',1) AS nodeType, (CASE substring_index(group_concat(t.warning_grade),',',1) WHEN '1' THEN substring_index(group_concat(t.warning_val_one),',',1) WHEN '2' THEN substring_index(group_concat(t.warning_val_two),',',1) WHEN '3' THEN substring_index(group_concat(t.warning_val_three),',',1) END) AS warningVal, substring_index(group_concat(t.warning_time),',',1) AS warningTime FROM( SELECT * FROM tb_early_warning WHERE warning_type = #{earlyWarningDto.warningType}) t INNER JOIN (SELECT stack_id,MAX(warning_grade) AS warning_grade FROM tb_early_warning WHERE 1=1 and warning_type = #{earlyWarningDto.warningType} and principal_name = #{earlyWarningDto.principalName} and warning_time >= #{earlyWarningDto.startTime} and warning_time <= #{earlyWarningDto.startTime} GROUP BY stack_id) t2 ON t.warning_grade = t2.warning_grade AND t2.stack_id = t.stack_id GROUP BY t.stack_id

select id, warning_type warningType , node_id nodeId , node_type nodeType , warning_val_one warningValOne , warning_time_one warningTimeOne , warning_val_two warningValTwo , warning_time_two warningTimeTwo , warning_val_three warningValThree , warning_time_three warningTimeThree , warning_grade warningGrade , stack_id stackId from tb_early_warning where stack_id = #{stackId} and is_affirm = 0 ;
select count(*) from tb_early_warning where node_id = #{nodeId} and is_affirm = 2 and warning_type = #{warningType}

#{earlyWarning.warningValOne},#{earlyWarning.warningValOne},
sysdate(),sysdate(),

sysdate(),sysdate(),
#{earlyWarning.warningValThree},#{earlyWarning.warningValTwo},
sysdate(),sysdate(), #{earlyWarning.warningGrade}, #{earlyWarning.stackId}, #{earlyWarning.areaId}, 2 )
mapper.update: update tb_early_warning set warning_grade = #{earlyWarning.warningGrade}, warning_val_two = #{earlyWarning.warningValTwo},warning_val = #{earlyWarning.warningValTwo}, warning_val_three = #{earlyWarning.warningValThree},warning_val = #{earlyWarning.warningValThree}, warning_time_two = sysdate(),warning_time = sysdate() warning_time_three = sysdate(),warning_time = sysdate() where id = #{earlyWarning.id}
mapper.select: select node_id nodeId, node_type nodeType, warning_val_one warningValOne, warning_time_one warningTimeOne from tb_early_warning where warning_type in ('01','02','03') and is_affirm = 2

SELECT warning_type AS warningType, DATE_FORMAT(deal_time,'%Y%m') AS dealTime, COUNT(warning_type) AS COUNT FROM tb_early_warning WHERE DATE_FORMAT(deal_time,'%Y%m') =DATE_FORMAT(CURDATE(),'%Y%m') GROUP BY warning_type,dealTime
